stories.title: Define triage display contract for frontend
stories.description: Define the UI data contract for trial triage results including recruiting status, condition match, pass/fail flag, and explanation text. Align with backend EVAL-CT-TRIAGE output and ensure compatibility with MessageBubble rendering.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx; Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/evaluate_care_quality/clinical_trials_service.py; GAP: No existing triage schema defined.

stories.title: Implement triage explanation rendering logic
stories.description: Build frontend logic to prioritize and render recruiting status and condition match before any quality metrics, including clear pass/fail indicators and human-readable explanations.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx; GAP: No triage rendering logic exists.

stories.title: Integrate triage data into chat response UI
stories.description: Wire triage results into the chat pipeline so that trial triage explanations are displayed within MessageBubble components, preserving ordering and formatting rules.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/ChatWindow.tsx; Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx; GAP: No triage UI integration currently exists.

stories.title: Add triage UI test coverage
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating that triage explanations render correctly, including ordering (triage before quality), pass/fail visibility, and fallback behavior when fields are missing.
stories.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/frontend/src/components/MessageBubble.tsx; Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/tests; GAP: No existing triage UI tests.
